allowedSettings.rule: Only exact natural default bytes may appear, include in imported snapshot and archive on restoration; no other source additions.

completionContract.receiptIdentity: The exact persisted receipt byte count and SHA-256 are emitted in the final stdout summary after write/flush and hash.
completionContract.externalAcceptance: Only a separately observed actual OS exit code 0, external monotonic duration <=120 seconds, matching receipt byte count/SHA-256, RESTORATION_CHECKS_PASS with no failure, exact 1035 projection, 43 compiler leaves, 62 protected preimages, and fresh no-consumer evidence can be recorded RECOVERED. Otherwise INCOMPLETE.
completionContract.postFlushDeadline: Check the total deadline after receipt flush and hash and again after stdout flush. If expired, return exit 1 even if the durable receipt/stdout still says AWAITING_PROCESS_EXIT.
completionContract.noRetryOrRewrite: Write the terminal receipt at most once. Serialization, write, hash, flush, or deadline failures return INCOMPLETE and exit 1; preserve any original failure and never rewrite a transient receipt.
